svg.title: Die shot of BZ10J, the chip of Bartosz Zambrzycki, junior Fullstack developer. The path of a request runs through the frontend in Angular · TypeScript, the backend in C# · .NET and the storage in SQL · Object Storage (S3). Under it sit Linux, Git · CI/CD · Docker and Bash · Python. Requests move one stage per clock tick and the response returns to the browser along the top lane.

g.text: Linux · Git · CI/CD · Docker · Bash · Python
